what_happened: Research found two of the dispatch's four defects partially stale as measured against the live codebase: (1) Defect 4's premise is moot -- roadmap-integration.sh's --prune is now a DEPRECATED alias for --regenerate (both render ## Next/## Open work wholly from state.json, so no terminal cruft can accumulate and there is nothing to prune), so the conclusion stage's exclusion of --prune needs no revisiting, only a possible comment update; (2) the territory note's claim of 'three other open records' declaring context/contracts/conclusion-stage.md is stale by one -- task 391 (agent-system task siting) completed and archived 2026-11-11, leaving only tasks 558 and 562 as currently-open co-declarers alongside 602 itself.

Two carried figures in the dispatch description re-derived false at plan time: the Territory Note's 'three other open records' declaring conclusion-stage.md is two (the third completed and archived), and the measured '138-task ready pool' re-derives to 75 live. Defect 4's premise (--prune built and working but excluded) is also dissolved: --prune is now a deprecated alias for --regenerate. All three recorded in the plan's Premise Re-Validation table rather than carried forward.

postflight-tool-restrictions.md's Move 5 Allowed Tool Surface table lists neither orchestrate-suggest-next-batch.sh nor lint-roadmap-batch-proposals.sh in its Bash row, although conclusion-stage.md's Step 7 and Step 5 already invoke both. The plan's Phase 4 repairs this alongside the AskUserQuestion row the new edge-write gate requires; the file was not in the task's declared file_scope.

The research report's line-level root-cause reading of suggest_from_pool() and its live measurement of the --prune deprecation were accurate on re-check, and its probe-budget sizing finding directly produced the plan's D1/D2 decisions. Planning needed no re-exploration of the script beyond confirming the cited line ranges.

Phase 2 of select_candidates_for_criterion() surfaced a pre-existing, latent parsing bug in select_candidates(): while IFS=$'\t' read -r t topic fs silently collapses an empty topic field (bash treats tab as IFS-whitespace, merging consecutive delimiters), corrupting fs_of/topic_of whenever topic is null/empty -- the common case. This made the new territory/topic criteria return wrong/empty pools. Fixed by switching the jq/read field separator to ASCII 0x1F, which bash never collapses. Verified via direct bash trace before/after the fix.

deploy-headless.sh's full gate run reports 3 pre-existing, unrelated failures across every redeploy in this dispatch, stable before and after this task's edits: gate10 (validate-state.sh --deep) exceeded its 60s timeout (environmental/load-related, not this task's code), gate20 eager-load total (71949B) over its recorded baseline (70400B), and skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md (25510B) over its 25000B ceiling. None of the three touched files are edited by this task (phases 1-2 only touch orchestrate-suggest-next-batch.sh and its test file, neither counted in the eager-load set or SKILL.md). Attributed as pre-existing per Phase 6's requirement; to be re-verified at Phase 6.
